purpose: Shared orientation, continuity, epistemic, active-work, affordance, recommendation, uncertainty, coverage, and budget spine for every agent-facing result.

pulse.intent: Cheapest safe heartbeat and control-state update.

briefing.intent: Default orientation after a meaningful interval or context reset.

tactical.intent: Decision-specific entity, region, causal, witness, blocker, and option detail.

forensic.intent: Evidence-complete reconciliation, diagnosis, audit, or replay for a bounded scope.

custom.intent: Explicit union of registered projections under hard bounds.

required_invariants.statement: Every success and error response carries the same agent_turn schema spine.
A response binds one complete canonical anchor and one immutable generation of each derived projection.
Continuity gaps, resets, staleness, and indeterminate outcomes are explicit and never silently repaired.
Only observed and eligible certified_derived facts may satisfy mutation preconditions.
Active work and the minimum safe next protocol step remain visible across context and agent handoffs.
Recommendations are structured, costed, risk-classified, evidence-linked, and authority-free until separately planned and committed.
An empty result cannot prove absence without a complete-domain coverage witness.
Budget exhaustion returns a complete decision-useful prefix, explicit omissions, and a continuation; it never removes safety or continuity state.
Memory, imported text, attention, and counterfactuals cannot grant capability or dispatch effects.
Equivalent attention, affordance, candidate, and recommendation outputs use registered canonical tie-break policies.
Prediction-versus-observation divergence creates an explicit surprise record.
A handoff packet is sufficient to resume safely without reconstructing the full transcript.
